overview: White pushes 5.c5 against the Alekhine knight on b6, and after ...Nd5 White continues Bc4 and Nc3 to hit the knight, with sharp gambit branches like Lasker Simul, Matsukevich and Mikenas where White gives a pawn. White has a space edge but overextends; Black attacks the e5 and c5 pawns with ...d6xe5 and ...b6.

white_ideas.idea: Gain space with c5, e5 and d4 and harass the Black knight
Develop quickly with Bc4 and Nc3

black_ideas.idea: Retreat and undermine the White chain with ...dxe5 or ...b6

typical_structures.structure: White chain e5/d4/c5 against Black d6 and e6

character.notes: Sharp theory-heavy lines with space versus counterattack.

gambit.notes: The main line has no material sacrificed; named gambits are side branches.

soundness.notes: Considered an ambitious sideline that Black can meet comfortably.

structure.notes: White's pawn chain is in tension with Black's attacks.

level.notes: Theory and understanding of a space-versus-counterplay structure.
